newsitem.title: USA: SmithKline to evaluate TCPI glucose test.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline to evaluate TCPI glucose test.

text.p: Technical Chemicals & Products Inc said Wednesday that it signed a contract with SmithKline Beecham to evaluate its TD glucose monitoring system for six months and negotiate a definitive licensing agreement to market the system.

Terms of the contract include an upfront payment to TCPI as well as the mutual exchange of technical and marketing information related to the product, a non-invasive monitoring system for use by diabetics. The company did not disclose the amount of the payment.

TCPI said the global demand for glucose monitoring products is estimated to be $2.5 billion a year and growing by 15 percent annually. At present, there are 11O million diabetics worldwide -- 18 million of whom regularly monitor their glucose levels.

The company said that it is on target with its original plans to have the product on the market in 1998. In the second half of this year, TCPI said it expects clinical trials of the glucose monitoring system will be completed and a corresponding filing made with the Food and Drug Administration.
